findings.impact: Existing-key CSV corrections disappear on reopen, including previously imported dates; dependent statistics also revert

sources.file: C:\Users\lenovo\Downloads\大仓缺货治理追踪看板.html

findings.fix: Persist additions and updates by date/warehouse/SKU; restored rows override embedded base; do not overwrite storage failure with success; preserve previous state on failure

findings.impact: A stale payment-derived file can cross the upload boundary after payment changes during browser acquisition; host validator correctly rejects it when called again
findings.fix: Fresh live host-basis check after slow browser preparation and before releasing actual import request; distinguish proven zero-submit rejection from accepted/unknown outcome; preserve receipt recovery and default concurrency

findings.impact: A valid unaffected warehouse becomes ineligible and its schedule is retired; queued work is skipped and manual retry is rejected
findings.fix: Resolve current warehouse execution identity/revision/digest; retain oid/visibility/payment checks; explicit revalidation can restore wrongly retired schedules without reviving deleted, voided or intentionally paused ones

findings.impact: Single and batch lifecycle order/store comparison export fails for valid older-source sibling warehouse
findings.fix: Use warehouse validation as authority; remove parent-latest equality while retaining immutable snapshot, duplicate-revision and real changed-warehouse checks

findings.impact: snapshot(_comparison=False) returns no display rows but still computes per-SKU differences, labels and notes
findings.fix: Guard the complete display-only block, not only row append; retain decoding/fingerprints, legacy completeness, payment documents and health checks

validation_methods.dashboard: Original script, synthetic data and simulated DOM/storage; reopen with a new JS VM. Not a real-browser persistence acceptance.
validation_methods.purchase: Actual machine/service/ledger/input validation with fake browser acquisition and upload transport; original host validator rerun afterwards. No platform requests.
validation_methods.warehouse: Production publish, warehouse validation, receipt eligibility/scheduling/manual queue and comparison collector on synthetic SQLite.
validation_methods.lightweight: Production snapshot with 1000 synthetic SKUs; trace verifies unused display work and full/light health equivalence. No post-fix speed claim.

probe_history.result: First combined probe completed purchase/warehouse checks, then failed a probe-only assertion expecting exactly 1000 line events. Comprehension resumes create multiple events.
Corrected probe-only line-event assertion passed; original failure retained; no production source changes.

implementation_boundaries: No real-data repair, platform operation, upload replay, Git commit/push/merge or rebuild in this audit
Historical wrongly retired schedules need explicit revalidation; do not auto-enable every schedule
Already closed dashboard corrections may need the source CSV imported again; do not invent missing corrections
unknown: Real business-machine hit counts were not read
No real platform accepted any request in these probes
Post-fix regression/performance/EXE acceptance will be required during implementation
